default_log_file.description: Path to the notifier service log file.

default_logging_context_format_string.description: Format string for context-aware logging messages.

default_logging_default_format_string.description: Format string for default logging messages.

default_logging_debug_format_suffix.description: Suffix appended to debug-level log entries.

rpc_transport_url.description: Message bus connection string (e.g., RabbitMQ or Redis). Replace RABBIT_PASSWORD with your password.

keystone_authtoken_project_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name for the project.

keystone_authtoken_user_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name for the user.

keystone_authtoken_project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) where the aodh service user resides.

keystone_authtoken_username.description: Keystone username for the aodh service.

keystone_authtoken_password.description: Password for the aodh service user in Keystone. Required.

oslo_concurrency_lock_path.description: Directory for process locking files (must be writable by aodh user).

alarm_enabled.description: Whether the notifier service is enabled.

alarm_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the notifier service.

alarm_evaluation_service.description: Name of the evaluation service (shared with aodh-evaluator); typically 'evaluator'.

alarm_notification_retries.description: Maximum number of delivery retries for alarm notifications.

alarm_notification_rules.description: List of alarm notification rules (one per alarm template).

name.description: Human-readable name for this notification rule.

threshold.description: Threshold condition (e.g., '>=', '>' — used only for some types).

alarm_id.description: Optional: specific alarm UUID to attach to this rule.

enabled.description: Whether this notification rule is active.

notification_endpoints.description: List of reusable notification endpoint definitions.

name.description: Unique name for this endpoint (used in actions).

method.description: HTTP method (e.g., 'POST', 'GET'). Required for HTTP(S) endpoints.

url.description: Full URL for the webhook or notification service (e.g., 'https://alerts.example.com/hook').

project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain (optional for service auth).

user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain (optional for service auth).

auth_url.description: Keystone auth URL for service tokens (optional).

alarm_actions.description: List of alarm actions mapped to states (OK, ALARM, INSUFFICIENT_DATA).

actions.description: List of action names referencing notification_endpoints or internal actions (e.g., 'log', 'panic', or endpoint names).

database_connection.description: Database connection URL (required if local storage is needed; typically shared with aodh-evaluator). Replace AODH_DBPASS.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL for service endpoints (e.g., for webhook destinations requiring HTTPS).

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM format).

tls_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying peer (optional).

service_credentials_project_domain_name.description: Project domain name for service credentials.

service_credentials_user_domain_name.description: User domain name for service credentials.

oslo_messaging_notifications_topic.description: RabbitMQ/Kafka topic to publish notifications to.

oslo_messaging_notifications_retry.description: Whether to retry notification delivery on transient failures.
